title: Talk Less, Learn More: Strategic Disclosure in Response to Managerial Learning from the Options Market

scopes.description: The complete author-supplied Stata/SAS preparation workflow and every supplied branch in CNY_Stata and SAS code.pdf, in its interleaved stage order, through the listed main and companion regression analyses. The package contains CNY_Identifier.xls as a firm identifier list, not a prepared analysis dataset; the separate appendix's unprovided OA1-OA7 analyses are contextual and are not executable branches in this scope.

requirements.description: OptionMetrics daily option observations in the author-named chunks. Required source fields are date, cp_flag, strike_price, best_bid, best_offer, volume, open_interest and cusip. The supplied Stata transforms parse dates, use strike_price/1000, midpoint (best_bid+best_offer)/2, and option value midpoint*volume*100 before matching daily CRSP stock prices and aggregating by firm-year-quarter. The target sample is 1996-2016; code names 1996-2009 annual/split chunks and 2010-2016 quarterly a-d chunks.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals consumed through the Stata 1950-2017 and 1950-2018 files and SAS COMP.FUNDA. issues.description: The substantial Stata and SAS program sections are embedded in a PDF rather than supplied as standalone drivers. They need extraction/reflow into working-copy files, ordinary host-visible roots, and the two supported working-copy syntax/reflow repairs preserved from the source.

SAS stages 4 and 8 export to Windows absolute paths while downstream Stata reads relative basenames; ordinary host-visible root/path mapping is run preparation. The exported fields/types and merge contracts at the Stata consumers still require verification. The stage 10 controls export/import already share [redacted-path-3090f1634575], but its retained fields must still match the consumer.

The package supplies a firm identifier list and embedded workflow code, not the prepared estimation data. All 26 consumed data products/files remain unverified for exact schema, units, population/history and construction; bounded one-row candidates do not establish full coverage.

The SAS controls DATA step starts with `COMP.FUNDA (keep=&vars)` where the defined KEEP list omits ROA; its intervening SAS DATA/SQL stages before the earnings-volatility block create no ROA. Both subsequent PROC SQL consumers reference b.roa, so the supplied SAS controls branch has a source-level missing-column blocker as written. The intended ROA producer/definition remains unresolved. Stata later derives roa=ib/at in another stage, but no handoff to the SAS controls table is supplied; do not insert a guessed definition.

The bounded COMP.FUNDA candidate request fails because SIC is absent from its catalog schema; the supplied main Stata panel explicitly reads sic and later constructs industry groups from sic. The same catalog has SICH, but no supported alias or mapping equates SICH with SIC here. Confirm the intended producer/field or author-export schema.

The supplied Stata ownership stage reads NCUSIP from msf_19252017.dta, whereas frozen CRSP.MSF metadata lists CUSIP and no NCUSIP. CRSP.STOCKNAMES has NCUSIP in its own dated-name table, but the code's direct monthly-file contract and author-export provenance do not establish a mapping from that separate source.

The supplied code directly reads CDS_incep_all.dta, gvkey_cusip.dta, cikgvkey.dta, mf_surprise.dta and 8k_98_119.dta without a producing step in the supplied PDF. Some source families are named in the datasheet, but exact preparation, identifiers/date semantics, fields and history are not specified. These remain input/producer contracts, not evidence that their terminal output branches need later consumers.

The Table 5 block contains four reghdfe inline 2SLS calls instrumenting LnOptvol with lnmoney. Local metadata establishes reghdfe 6.12.3 and ftools 2.49.1, not support for this older inline-IV form. Maintainer help documents IV/2SLS in reghdfe v3, its move to ivreghdfe from v4, and a version(3) compatibility option; the exact author-targeted version/backend and whether the installed legacy path accepts these calls remain unverified. ivreg2 and ivreghdfe availability are not established. Preserve the author equation and fixed effects; do not automatically substitute a backend or assert equivalence.

evidence.description: Embedded Stata code reads separately named OptionMetrics files beginning in 1996 and lists annual and intra-year chunks.
evidence.quote:
*** Option data
** 1996-2009
foreach j in 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008a 2008b
2008c 2008d 2009a 2009b 2009c 2009d {


use date cp_flag strike_price best_bid best_offer volume open_interest cusip using `j'.dta, clear
rename cusip ncusip

evidence.description: Option processing rescales strike_price, computes option price from bid/offer, matches daily CRSP stock price, and aggregates volume/value by firm-year-quarter.
evidence.quote:
gen xprc=strike_price/1000
gen optprc=(best_bid+best_offer)/2


gen qtr=1
replace qtr=2 if month==4|month==5|month==6
replace qtr=3 if month==7|month==8|month==9
replace qtr=4 if month==10|month==11|month==12


merge m:1 permno date using stkprice
keep if _m==3
drop _m


gen value=optprc*volume*100
sort ncusip year qtr
bys ncusip year qtr: egen optvol=sum(volume)
bys ncusip year qtr: egen doptvol=sum(value)

evidence.description: SAS exports the linked forecast table to an absolute path; the following Stata stage opens the same basename from its current directory.
The SAS controls stage selects Compustat fiscal years 1984–2017 and constructs beginning/end fiscal-year dates.
The rolling earnings-volatility control uses earlier ROA observations over a ten-year window and requires at least five nonmissing ROAs.
Later Stata construction creates the estimation sample, trims it to 1996–2016, and prepares the main Table 3 regressions.
evidence.quote:
global contro logmv bm roa pmihtt csaret12 earnvol loss gkslagc_litigation lnanalst lev z_score
seo stkvol stk_turnover
egen miss1=rowmiss($contro)
drop if miss1 !=0
drop miss1
drop if lnoptvol==.


* winsorize
winsor2 lnoptvol lnfreq_all_f1 width_all_f1 dispersion1 $contro, cuts(1 99) replace
winsor2 sale, cuts(1 99) replace


* Mid Z_score
bys year: quantiles z_score, gen(x_zscore) nq(5)
gen mid_zscore=1 if x_zscore==3
replace mid_zscore=0 if x_zscore!=3 & x_zscore!=.


gen Ind = floor(sic/100)
tab year, gen(d_year)


keep if (year>=1996) & (year<=2016)
rename (forecast_all_f1 lnfreq_all_f1) (DumMF FreqMF)
rename (logmv bm roa pmihtt csaret12 earnvol loss gkslagc_litigation lnanalst lev mid_zscore
seo stkvol stk_turnover) ///
(Size BM ROA IO Ret EarnVol Loss Litigation Analyst Lev Mid_Zscore Issue Stkvol Turnover)

rename lnoptvol LnOptvol


global contro Size Lev BM ROA Loss IO Analyst Ret EarnVol Stkvol Turnover Litigation
Mid_Zscore Issue
save regall, replace




***************************************
***       Regression for Main Tables     ***
***************************************
* Table 3
use regall, clear
reghdfe DumMF LnOptvol $contro d_year*, absorb(gvkey) cluster(gvkey)
reghdfe FreqMF LnOptvol $contro d_year*, absorb(gvkey) cluster(gvkey)

The data was downloaded on May 16, 2018. We obtained the options data from Option Metrics
on January 15, 2019. Firm financial statements data was obtained from Compustat, which was
downloaded on June 23, 2018. Stock return data was downloaded from CRSP on September 18,

Institutional ownership data was acquired from Thomson-Reuters Institutional Holdings (13F),
which was downloaded on July 4, 2018. Equity issuance data was obtained from Thomson One,
and was downloaded on July 21, 2018. CDS data was obtained from Markit on October 5, 2019.
Financial statement comparability data was obtained from De Franco et al. [2011]
(https://mitmgmtfaculty.mit.edu/rverdi/). Insider options trading data was downloaded from
Thomson Reuters Insiders Data on Jan 13, 2020. Voluntary 8-K filing data was obtained from the
SEC’s Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval online system (EDGAR) on Apr 24,
2019. Quarterly conference call data was obtained from Bushee et al. [2018] (https://accounting-
faculty.wharton.upenn.edu/dtayl/code/).

evidence.description: Initial daily CRSP reads create the daily stock-price table, annual stock volume/dollar volume and dated stock-name key used by later options stages.
evidence.quote:
*** CRSP stock price
use cusip permno date prc using "dsf_19252017.dta", clear
replace prc=abs(prc)
rename cusip cusip8
sort permno date
duplicates drop
duplicates list permno date
save stkprice, replace




*** CRSP stock volume
use cusip permno date prc vol using "dsf_19252017.dta", clear
duplicates drop
/*Volume is set to -99 if the value is missing.*/
drop if vol==. | vol==-99


rename cusip cusip8
gen year=year(date)
bys cusip8 year: egen stkvol=sum(vol)
gen value=abs(prc)*vol
bys cusip8 year: egen dstkvol=sum(value)

keep cusip8 permno year stkvol dstkvol
duplicates drop
duplicates list cusip8 year
save stkvol, replace


use "stocknames.dta", clear
sort ncusip namedt
save "stocknames.dta", replace

evidence.description: The later OptionMetrics block names quarterly a-d files from 2010 through 2016 and reads the same core option fields.
